spatial_group_rule: Shared building IDs or AOI gap <100m; transitive components never cross splits
teacher_profile: physics-only probability score; learned risk injected differentiably inside policy forward
training_schedule: Seeded training-map permutation, fresh seed per slot; each map covers 2 directions x3 jammer kinds across six cycles
predictor: One Transformer encoder and risk head. No GRU, no LightGBM probabilities in standalone inputs/candidate scores/policy/critic.
reward: Frozen v3 communications-priority reward; no reward coefficient changes mid-run
selection: Validation only: all complete/safe, max duration ratio<=1.15, PDR>=frozen baseline-.0005; maximize connectivity then timely delivery, then shorter longest outages
alarm_selection: Validation only; maximize first-alert event recall with >=3s lead subject to precision>=.8 and false/drone-hour<=5; explicitly report infeasible rules
operational_limits: Simulation only; no claim of real-flight, Wi-Fi, battery or autopilot certification
